verses.greek: Ὡς οὖν ἔγνω ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤκουσαν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ὅτι Ἰησοῦς πλείονας μαθητὰς ποιεῖ καὶ βαπτίζει ἢ Ἰωάννης—
verses.literal: When therefore knew the Jesus that heard the Pharisees that Jesus more disciples makes and baptizes than John
verses.dgt: So when Jesus learned that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John—

verses.greek: καίτοιγε Ἰησοῦς αὐτὸς οὐκ ἐβάπτιζεν ἀλλʼ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ—
verses.literal: and certainly indeed Jesus Himself not was baptizing but the disciples of Him
verses.dgt: although Jesus himself was not baptizing, but his disciples were—

verses.greek: ἀφῆκεν τὴν Ἰουδαίαν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πάλιν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.
verses.literal: He left the Judea and went away again into the Galilee.
verses.dgt: he left Judea and went back again to Galilee.

verses.greek: ἔδει δὲ αὐτὸν διέρχεσθαι διὰ τῆς Σαμαρείας.
verses.literal: It was necessary for now Him to pass through the Samaria.
verses.dgt: But he had to pass through Samaria.

verses.greek: ἔρχεται οὖν εἰς πόλιν τῆς Σαμαρείας λεγομένην Συχὰρ πλησίον τοῦ χωρίου ὃ ἔδωκεν Ἰακὼβ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ·
verses.literal: He comes therefore to a city the of Samaria being named Sychar nearby the plot of ground that gave Jacob the to Joseph the son of him
verses.dgt: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the field that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.

verses.greek: ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ πηγὴ τοῦ Ἰακώβ. ὁ οὖν Ἰησοῦς κεκοπιακὼς ἐκ τῆς ὁδοιπορίας ἐκαθέζετο οὕτως ἐπὶ τῇ πηγῇ· ὥρα ἦν ὡς ἕκτη.
verses.literal: Was now there the well the of Jacob. the Therefore Jesus already wearying from the journey was sitting thus at the well The hour was about the sixth.
verses.dgt: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus, tired from the journey, was sitting by the well just as he was. It was about the sixth hour.

verses.greek: Ἔρχεται γυνὴ ἐκ τῆς Σαμαρείας ἀντλῆσαι ὕδωρ. λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Δός μοι πεῖν·
verses.literal: Comes a woman out of the Samaria to draw water. Says to her the Jesus do give Me to drink.
verses.dgt: A woman from Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

verses.greek: οἱ γὰρ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπεληλύθεισαν εἰς τὴν πόλιν, ἵνα τροφὰς ἀγοράσωσιν.
verses.literal: the For the disciples of Him had gone away into the city that food they may buy.
verses.dgt: For his disciples had gone into the city to buy food.

verses.greek: λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ ἡ γυνὴ ἡ Σαμαρῖτις· Πῶς σὺ Ἰουδαῖος ὢν παρʼ ἐμοῦ πεῖν αἰτεῖς γυναικὸς Σαμαρίτιδος οὔσης; οὐ γὰρ συγχρῶνται Ἰουδαῖοι Σαμαρίταις.
verses.literal: Says therefore to Him the woman the Samaritan How You yourself a Jew being from me to drink you do ask a woman Samaritan being? Not for have association Jews with Samaritans.
verses.dgt: So the Samaritan woman said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask me for a drink, when I am a Samaritan woman?” For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Εἰ ᾔδεις τὴν δωρεὰν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ λέγων σοι· Δός μοι πεῖν, σὺ ἂν ᾔτησας αὐτὸν καὶ ἔδωκεν ἄν σοι ὕδωρ ζῶν.
verses.literal: Answered Jesus and said to her If you had known the gift the of God and who it is who is saying to you do give Me to drink you yourself then would you have asked Him and He gave maybe to you water living.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ γυνή· Κύριε, οὔτε ἄντλημα ἔχεις καὶ τὸ φρέαρ ἐστὶν βαθύ· πόθεν οὖν ἔχεις τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ζῶν;
verses.literal: Says to Him the woman: Sir nothing to draw with You have and the well is deep from where then have You the water which is living?
verses.dgt: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get this living water?

verses.greek: μὴ σὺ μείζων εἶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἰακώβ, ὃς ἔδωκεν ἡμῖν τὸ φρέαρ καὶ αὐτὸς ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἔπιεν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ θρέμματα αὐτοῦ;
verses.literal: Not You yourself greater are than the father of us Jacob who gave us the well and himself of it drank and the sons of him and the livestock of him?
verses.dgt: You are not greater than our father Jacob, are you? He gave us the well, and he himself drank from it, along with his sons and his livestock.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Πᾶς ὁ πίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος τούτου διψήσει πάλιν·
verses.literal: Answered Jesus and said to her Everyone who is drinking of the water this will thirst again.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks from this water will thirst again,

verses.greek: ὃς δʼ ἂν πίῃ ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος οὗ ἐγὼ δώσω αὐτῷ, οὐ μὴ διψήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, ἀλλὰ τὸ ὕδωρ ὃ δώσω αὐτῷ γενήσεται ἐν αὐτῷ πηγὴ ὕδατος ἁλλομένου εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.literal: whoever however maybe may drink of the water that I myself will give to him certainly not will thirst to the age Instead the water that I will give to him it will become in him a spring of water welling up into life eternal.
verses.dgt: but whoever drinks from the water that I will give him will never thirst. Instead, the water that I will give him will become in him a spring of water welling up to eternal life.”

verses.greek: λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ γυνή· Κύριε, δός μοι τοῦτο τὸ ὕδωρ, ἵνα μὴ διψῶ μηδὲ διέρχωμαι ἐνθάδε ἀντλεῖν.
verses.literal: Says to Him the woman Sir do give me this the water that not I may thirst nor I may come here to draw.
verses.dgt: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I will not thirst or keep coming here to draw.”

verses.greek: Λέγει αὐτῇ· Ὕπαγε φώνησον τὸν ἄνδρα σου καὶ ἐλθὲ ἐνθάδε.
verses.literal: He says to her do go do call the husband of you and do come here.
verses.dgt: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη ἡ γυνὴ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Οὐκ ἔχω ἄνδρα. λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Καλῶς εἶπας ὅτι Ἄνδρα οὐκ ἔχω·
verses.literal: Answered the woman and said to Him: Not I have a husband. Says to her the Jesus Correctly you have spoken that A husband not I have
verses.dgt: The woman answered him, “I do not have a husband.” Jesus said to her, “You have spoken correctly when you say, ‘I do not have a husband,’

verses.greek: πέντε γὰρ ἄνδρας ἔσχες, καὶ νῦν ὃν ἔχεις οὐκ ἔστιν σου ἀνήρ· τοῦτο ἀληθὲς εἴρηκας.
verses.literal: Five for husbands you have had and now he whom you have not is your husband this truly you have spoken.
verses.dgt: for you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. What you have said is true.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ γυνή· Κύριε, θεωρῶ ὅτι προφήτης εἶ σύ.
verses.literal: Says to Him the woman Sir I understand that a prophet are You yourself.
verses.dgt: The woman said to him, “Sir, I see that you are a prophet.

verses.greek: οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ προσεκύνησαν· καὶ ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐστὶν ὁ τόπος ὅπου προσκυνεῖν δεῖ.
verses.literal: The fathers of us on the mountain this worshiped and you yourselves say that in Jerusalem is the place where to worship it is necessary.
verses.dgt: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you say that Jerusalem is the place where people must worship.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Πίστευέ μοι, γύναι, ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα ὅτε οὔτε ἐν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ οὔτε ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις προσκυνήσετε τῷ πατρί.
verses.literal: Says to her the Jesus do believe Me woman that is coming an hour when neither you will worship on the mountain this nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
verses.dgt: Jesus said to her, “Believe me, woman, an hour is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.

verses.greek: ὑμεῖς προσκυνεῖτε ὃ οὐκ οἴδατε, ἡμεῖς προσκυνοῦμεν ὃ οἴδαμεν, ὅτι ἡ σωτηρία ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἐστίν·
verses.literal: You yourselves worship what not you know we ourselves worship what we know for the salvation of the Jews is.
verses.dgt: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we know, because salvation is from the Jews.

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ νῦν ἐστιν, ὅτε οἱ ἀληθινοὶ προσκυνηταὶ προσκυνήσουσιν τῷ πατρὶ ἐν πνεύματι καὶ ἀληθείᾳ, καὶ γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ τοιούτους ζητεῖ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας αὐτόν·
verses.literal: But is coming an hour and now is when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth also for the Father such seeks who worship Him.
verses.dgt: But an hour is coming, and now is here, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth. Indeed, the Father seeks such people to worship him.

verses.greek: πνεῦμα ὁ θεός, καὶ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας αὐτὸν ἐν πνεύματι καὶ ἀληθείᾳ δεῖ προσκυνεῖν.
verses.literal: Spirit the God is and those worshiping Him in spirit and truth it behooves to worship.
verses.dgt: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ γυνή· Οἶδα ὅτι Μεσσίας ἔρχεται, ὁ λεγόμενος χριστός· ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐκεῖνος, ἀναγγελεῖ ἡμῖν ἅπαντα.
verses.literal: Says to Him the woman I know that Messiah is coming who is called Christ when may come He He will tell us all things.
verses.dgt: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, the one called Christ. When he comes, he will tell us everything.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐγώ εἰμι, ὁ λαλῶν σοι.
verses.literal: Says to her the Jesus I myself am He who is speaking to you.
verses.dgt: Jesus said to her, “I am he—the one speaking to you.”

verses.greek: Καὶ ἐπὶ τούτῳ ἦλθαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ὅτι μετὰ γυναικὸς ἐλάλει· οὐδεὶς μέντοι εἶπεν· Τί ζητεῖς; ἢ τί λαλεῖς μετʼ αὐτῆς;
verses.literal: And upon this came the disciples of Him and were amazed that with a woman He was speaking no one however said What seek You? Or Why speak You with her?
verses.dgt: At that point his disciples came, and they were amazed that he was speaking with a woman. Yet no one said, “What are you seeking?” or, “Why are you speaking with her?”

verses.greek: ἀφῆκεν οὖν τὴν ὑδρίαν αὐτῆς ἡ γυνὴ καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ λέγει τοῖς ἀνθρώποις·
verses.literal: Left then the water pot of her the woman and went away into the city and says to the men
verses.dgt: Then the woman left her water jar, went into the city, and said to the people,

dgt.reason: Master review: replaced lexically implausible target with unique nearby unused exact match

verses.greek: Δεῦτε ἴδετε ἄνθρωπον ὃς εἶπέ μοι πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησα· μήτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ χριστός;
verses.literal: Come do see a man who told me all things as much as I did surely not ever this is the Christ?
verses.dgt: “Come, see a man who told me everything I have done. Could this possibly be the Christ?”

verses.greek: ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτόν.
verses.literal: They went forth out of the city and were coming unto Him.
verses.dgt: They went out of the city and were coming to him.

verses.greek: Ἐν τῷ μεταξὺ ἠρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ λέγοντες· Ῥαββί, φάγε.
verses.literal: But in the meantime were asking Him the disciples saying Rabbi do eat.
verses.dgt: Meanwhile the disciples were urging him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἐγὼ βρῶσιν ἔχω φαγεῖν ἣν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε.
verses.literal: the But He said to them I myself food have to eat that you yourselves not know.
verses.dgt: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you do not know about.”

verses.greek: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ μαθηταὶ πρὸς ἀλλήλους· Μή τις ἤνεγκεν αὐτῷ φαγεῖν;
verses.literal: Were saying therefore the disciples to one another Surely not one did bring to Him something to eat?
verses.dgt: So the disciples were saying to one another, “No one brought him something to eat, did they?”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐμὸν βρῶμά ἐστιν ἵνα ποιήσω τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με καὶ τελειώσω αὐτοῦ τὸ ἔργον.
verses.literal: Says to them the Jesus My own food is that I may do the will of the One who having sent Me and may finish of Him the work.
verses.dgt: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of the one who sent me and to finish his work.

verses.greek: οὐχ ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι Ἔτι τετράμηνός ἐστιν καὶ ὁ θερισμὸς ἔρχεται; ἰδοὺ λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐπάρατε τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ θεάσασθε τὰς χώρας ὅτι λευκαί εἰσιν πρὸς θερισμόν· ἤδη
verses.literal: Surely you yourselves say that yet four months it is and the harvest comes? Behold I say to you do lift up the eyes of you and do see the fields because white they are toward harvest already!
verses.dgt: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months, and then the harvest comes’? Look, I tell you: lift up your eyes and see the fields, because they are already white for harvest.

verses.greek: ὁ θερίζων μισθὸν λαμβάνει καὶ συνάγει καρπὸν εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, ἵνα ὁ σπείρων ὁμοῦ χαίρῃ καὶ ὁ θερίζων.
verses.literal: the one reaping a reward receives and he gathers fruit unto life eternal so that who is sowing together may rejoice and who is reaping.
verses.dgt: The one who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit for eternal life, so that the one who sows and the one who reaps may rejoice together.

verses.greek: ἐν γὰρ τούτῳ ὁ λόγος ἐστὶν ἀληθινὸς ὅτι Ἄλλος ἐστὶν ὁ σπείρων καὶ ἄλλος ὁ θερίζων·
verses.literal: In for this the saying is true that One is who is sowing and another is the one who is reaping.
verses.dgt: For in this the saying is true: ‘One sows and another reaps.’

verses.greek: ἐγὼ ἀπέστειλα ὑμᾶς θερίζειν ὃ οὐχ ὑμεῖς κεκοπιάκατε· ἄλλοι κεκοπιάκασιν, καὶ ὑμεῖς εἰς τὸν κόπον αὐτῶν εἰσεληλύθατε.
verses.literal: I myself sent you to reap what not you yourselves have toiled for others have toiled and you yourselves into the labor of them have entered.
verses.dgt: I sent you to reap what you did not labor for. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

verses.greek: Ἐκ δὲ τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν τῶν Σαμαριτῶν διὰ τὸν λόγον τῆς γυναικὸς μαρτυρούσης ὅτι Εἶπέν μοι πάντα ἃ ἐποίησα.
verses.literal: Out of now the city that many believed in Him of the Samaritans because of the word of the woman testifying that He told me all things whatever I did.
verses.dgt: Many of the Samaritans from that city believed in him because of the woman’s testimony: “He told me everything I did.”

verses.greek: ὡς οὖν ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ Σαμαρῖται, ἠρώτων αὐτὸν μεῖναι παρʼ αὐτοῖς· καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐκεῖ δύο ἡμέρας.
verses.literal: When therefore came to Him the Samaritans they were asking Him to abide with them. and He stayed there two days.
verses.dgt: So when the Samaritans came to him, they asked him to stay with them, and he stayed there two days.

verses.greek: καὶ πολλῷ πλείους ἐπίστευσαν διὰ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ,
verses.literal: And many more believed because of the word of Him
verses.dgt: And many more believed because of his word.

verses.greek: τῇ τε γυναικὶ ἔλεγον ὅτι Οὐκέτι διὰ τὴν σὴν λαλιὰν πιστεύομεν· αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀκηκόαμεν, καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ σωτὴρ τοῦ κόσμου.
verses.literal: the and to the woman they were saying that no longer because of the your speech we believe we ourselves for have heard and we know that this is truly the Savior of the world
verses.dgt: They were saying to the woman, “We no longer believe merely because of what you said, for we ourselves have heard, and we know that this truly is the Savior of the world.”

verses.greek: Μετὰ δὲ τὰς δύο ἡμέρας ἐξῆλθεν ἐκεῖθεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν·
verses.literal: After then the two days He went forth from there into the Galilee.
verses.dgt: After the two days he left there and went to Galilee.

verses.greek: αὐτὸς γὰρ Ἰησοῦς ἐμαρτύρησεν ὅτι προφήτης ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ πατρίδι τιμὴν οὐκ ἔχει.
verses.literal: Himself for Jesus testified that a prophet in the own hometown honor not has.
verses.dgt: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own homeland.

verses.greek: ὅτε οὖν ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, ἐδέξαντο αὐτὸν οἱ Γαλιλαῖοι, πάντα ἑωρακότες ὅσα ἐποίησεν ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ, καὶ αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν.
verses.literal: When therefore He came into the Galilee received Him the Galileans all things having seen how much He had done in Jerusalem during the feast also themselves for they had gone to the feast.
verses.dgt: So when he came to Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him, having seen everything he had done in Jerusalem at the feast, for they too had gone to the feast.

verses.greek: Ἦλθεν οὖν πάλιν εἰς τὴν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας, ὅπου ἐποίησεν τὸ ὕδωρ οἶνον. καὶ ἦν τις βασιλικὸς οὗ ὁ υἱὸς ἠσθένει ἐν Καφαρναούμ.
verses.literal: He came therefore again to the Cana the of Galilee where He had made the water wine. And there was a certain royal official whose the son was sick in Capernaum.
verses.dgt: Then he came again to Cana of Galilee, where he had made the water wine. There was a royal official whose son was sick in Capernaum.

verses.greek: οὗτος ἀκούσας ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἥκει ἐκ τῆς Ἰουδαίας εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν ἀπῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἠρώτα ἵνα καταβῇ καὶ ἰάσηται αὐτοῦ τὸν υἱόν, ἤμελλεν γὰρ ἀποθνῄσκειν.
verses.literal: He having heard that Jesus had come out of the Judea into the Galilee went to Him and was asking that He may come down and He may heal his the son he was about for to die.
verses.dgt: When this man heard that Jesus had come from Judea into Galilee, he went to him and asked him to come down and heal his son, for he was about to die.

verses.greek: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς αὐτόν· Ἐὰν μὴ σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα ἴδητε, οὐ μὴ πιστεύσητε.
verses.literal: Said therefore the Jesus to him only unless signs and wonders you people may see certainly not shall you believe.
verses.dgt: So Jesus said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will certainly not believe.”

verses.greek: λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ βασιλικός· Κύριε, κατάβηθι πρὶν ἀποθανεῖν τὸ παιδίον μου.
verses.literal: Says to Him the royal official Sir do come down before to die the child of mine.
verses.dgt: The royal official said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Πορεύου· ὁ υἱός σου ζῇ. ἐπίστευσεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῷ λόγῳ ὃν εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἐπορεύετο.
verses.literal: Says to him the Jesus do go the son of you lives. Believed the man in the word that said to him the Jesus and he was going.
verses.dgt: Jesus said to him, “Go; your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him and went on his way.

verses.greek: ἤδη δὲ αὐτοῦ καταβαίνοντος οἱ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ ὑπήντησαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες ὅτι ὁ παῖς αὐτοῦ ζῇ.
verses.literal: Already then when he is going down the servants of him met with him saying that the boy of him lives.
verses.dgt: While he was already going down, his servants met him and reported that his boy was alive.

verses.greek: ἐπύθετο οὖν τὴν ὥραν παρʼ αὐτῶν ἐν ᾗ κομψότερον ἔσχεν· εἶπαν οὖν αὐτῷ ὅτι Ἐχθὲς ὥραν ἑβδόμην ἀφῆκεν αὐτὸν ὁ πυρετός.
verses.literal: He inquired therefore the hour from them in which better he got. They said therefore to him that Yesterday at hour seventh left him the fever.
verses.dgt: So he asked them the hour when he had begun to get better. They said to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.”

verses.greek: ἔγνω οὖν ὁ πατὴρ ὅτι ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐν ᾗ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὁ υἱός σου ζῇ, καὶ ἐπίστευσεν αὐτὸς καὶ ἡ οἰκία αὐτοῦ ὅλη.
verses.literal: Knew therefore the father that it was that very the hour at which said to him the Jesus The son of You lives. And he believed himself and the household of him all.
verses.dgt: Then the father knew that it was at that very hour when Jesus had said to him, “Your son lives.” And he himself believed, along with his whole household.

verses.greek: τοῦτο δὲ πάλιν δεύτερον σημεῖον ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐλθὼν ἐκ τῆς Ἰουδαίας εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.
verses.literal: This is now again the second sign did the Jesus having come out of the Judea into the Galilee.
verses.dgt: This was again the second sign Jesus did after coming from Judea into Galilee.
